note: Issue #609: NPCs who drive a speeder. Read by src/systems/ai/speeder_brain.gd (SpeederBrain: how they drive) and src/systems/vehicles/speeder_node.gd (getting on and off). A driver drives the same speeder and HoverModel as the player (content/core/vehicles/speeder.json); only how well is set here. `skills` are blocks over `default`: steer_gain (how hard it steers for an angle), point_reach (m: a point counts as passed this close), brake_time (s of speed ahead it starts slowing for the next turn), corner_slow (0..1: how much a sharp turn slows it), min_corner (the least share of top speed it keeps for any turn), boost (0..1: the chance each half second it is willing to boost), boost_angle_deg and boost_dist (m: only nearly straight on and this far out), wander_m (m it wanders off the line), look_min and look_ahead_s (how far ahead it looks for walls: m plus s of speed), avoid_margin (m kept round things to avoid), hold_range (m a pursuer holds behind its target), lead_s (s it leads a moving target), fire_cone_deg (it fires when the target is this close to its nose), park_reach (m) and park_face_deg. `rules` apply to every driver: stuck_s and backoff_s (pressing on without moving this long: back off this long), board_timeout_s (gives up walking to a speeder), thrown_damage (hp a rider loses when the speeder bursts under them; never lethal).
